SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_9 FROM keptrxl WHERE DOC_NAME = 'VERIFY' AND KEY_10 = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE ,'$G_RS.KEY_1$' AS JOB_ID ,'ILSH' AS BUYER ,'C' AS STATUS ,PO_NO AS LEGACY_NO ,PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_SEQ ,ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE ,nvl(pr_no, ' ') as REF_NO1 ,nvl(item_no, ' ') as BUYER_ITEM_NO ,nvl(unit_price, 0) as UNIT_PRICE ,nvl(item_qty, 0) as ITEM_QTY FROM view_po WHERE ADD_DATE BETWEEN '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND '$G_RS.KEY_3$'
UPDATE keptrxl SET KEY_9 = to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') ,KEY_10 = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND doc_name = 'VERIFY' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.KEY_3$' AND KEY_9 = '$G_RS.KEY_9$' AND KEY_10 = 'N'
SET KEY_9 = to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') ,KEY_10 = 'E' WHERE 1=1 AND doc_name = 'VERIFY' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.KEY_3$' AND KEY_9 = '$G_RS.KEY_9$' AND KEY_10 = 'N'
